## Why human

Outreach is relationship work under the maintainer's name; AI-drafted mass pitches are detectable and brand-negative. Context: the June 2026 round-ups (e.g. merge-json-files.com "9 Best Markdown Extensions for VS Code in 2026", May 26, 2026) recommend ZERO WYSIWYG editors and even lament the lack of visual table editing — the gap Muninn fills (`docs/MARKET_POSITION_2026-06.md` §2.6).

## Prerequisites

GA shipped (#001 chain), hero asset (#028), round-trip report (#003) — outreach needs proof links.

## Steps

1. Build the target list (8–12): authors of 2025–2026 "best markdown VS Code" posts (merge-json-files, markdownguide.org, allmarkdowntools.com, builder.io, mayashavin.com per the June research), plus the new "WYSIWYG markdown editors" listicle category (md-edit.com).
2. Personal note per author: what their list is missing (visual table editing in-editor), one GIF, one differentiator line ("doesn't rewrite your bytes — here's the test report"), no ask beyond "worth a look for your next update".
3. Track in a simple `docs/OUTREACH.md` table (who/when/response); 3+ independent mentions by end of 2026 is the roadmap metric.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] 8+ personalized contacts sent post-GA; tracker committed
- [ ] Zero copy-paste blast (each note references the author's actual content)
